message.reasoning:
The user wants to check different options for booking flight 1234. They want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024 (i.e., 2024-10-31), business class. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about insurance? The user didn't mention insurance. So just flight cost. Also maybe they want to see if they can book? They said "I need to arrange a flight as soon as possible on booking number 1234". That implies they might want to change the booking? Actually they want to check different options. So we need to compute cost. Provide estimated total payable amount. We don't have to book yet. Just compute cost. So we need to call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first airport code, travel_to=last airport code, travel_date="2024-10-31", travel_class="business".

But we also need to know the user's access token. We need to authenticate. We need client_id, client_secret, refresh_token, grant_type, user_first_name, user_last_name. We don't have those. We could ask the user for them. But the user hasn't provided. We could attempt to call get_login_status to see if already logged in. Let's call travel_get_login_status.
